title: Ajeeb zid hai
body:
ajeeb zid hai ke islam aal se mat lo
<<DIVIDER>>
har ek baat suno har kisi se fatwa lo
kahe jo aale mohamed usay kabhi na suno
ek shehre ilm ka dar hai udhar ka rukh na karo
suni sunayi hui baat par yaqeen karlo
ajeeb zid hai ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
zaban pe lao na hargiz nabi ki aal ka naam
jhukao ghair ke dar par jabeen ko subho shaam
ye ahlebait hai bas laaeq e darood o salaam
inhe to door se hi bas salaam karte raho
ajeeb zid hai ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
badhayi jis se ibaarat hai ye wo aazam hai
usool e deen hai ibne rasool e khaatam hai
imam e jafar e sadiq imam e aalam hai
khuda ke waaste kuch to samajh ki baat karo
ajeeb zid hai ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
ghatao martaba aale mustafa din raat
usool e kasrat e aara se unko dedo maat
ye inteha e adawat hai ke har ek wo baat
jawan ke haq mein kahi jaaye usko kufr kaho
ajeeb zid hai ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
khuda ke waaste is zid se baaz aajao
jahan mein dushmane aale nabi na kehlao
gala kata chuke shabbir kuch taras khao
nabi ki aal pe ab to sitam rawan na rakho
ajeeb zid hai ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye ahlebait hai haasil inhe ye azmat hai
ke lab pe naam bhi aajaye to ibadat hai
sune wo deen e mohamed se jinko nisbat hai
hai char chand lage in se deen e ahmed ko
ajeeb zid hai ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
har ek bashar ko ye haasil kahan sa'adat hai
jali huroof se quran mein ibaarat hai
ke sirf aale ibrahim mein imamat hai
wahan bhi shart rakhi hai na zalimeen mein ho
ajeeb zid hai ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai aal rooh aur islam us ka qalib hai
qadam qadam pe wo inki riza ka taalib hai
hai kaun jis pe durood o salaam wajib hai
hai haq parasti ka daawa to haq ki baat kaho
ajeeb zid hai ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
zaban se kehte ho dil se yaqeen gar ho jaye
kham ahlebait ki chaukat pe tera sar ho jaye
mai karbala kahun aur teri chashm nam ho jaye
azeez jaan se zyada hussain ka gham ho
ajeeb zid hai ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
hussain jaan dil e mustafa pe jaan nisaar
nazar mein taab kahan hai jo dekhe haalat e zaar
tan e hazeen pe hai itne sina o teer ke waar
shumaar karne pe aaye magar shumaar na ho
ajeeb zid hai ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
pisar ki laassh pe baithe thay sayyed e waala
ke ek mard khush atwar saamne aaya
salaam kar ke kaha mai hoon qaside sughra
tadap raahi hai bulaya hai us ne akbar ko
ajeeb zid hai ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
suna jo fatema sughra ka naam sarwar ne
kaleje thaam liya fatema ke dilbar ne
tadap ke khaak pe karwat li laashe akbar ne
larazte haathon se thaama hussain ne khat ko
ajeeb zid hai ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
likha tha khat mein hazaron salaam akbar ko
duayein bali sakina ko pyar asghar ko
chacha ko likha tha aadaab aur sarwar ko
likha tha baba gaye bhool aap bhi mujhko
ajeeb zid hai ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
mai raat din yahan bhai ki raah dekhti thi
aur aap ne wahan shadi racha di kubra ki
kisi ko aayi na aise mein yaad sughra ki
bigad gaya hai muqaddar kahun mai kya isko
ajeeb zid hai ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
chacha ke paas sakina hai mai hoon kaun bhala
phupi ko bhi nahi aaya khayal kuch mera
samajhti hongi ye amma ke mar gayi sughra
kisi ka bhi na jahan mein aisa naseeb ho
ajeeb zid hai ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
ye pad ke aah jo ki sheh ne aasman larza
hila ke shaana e akbar kaha ke ay beta
bulaya hai tumhe sughra ne doon jawab mein kya
madine jaoge kab tak behen ke laane ko
ajeeb zid hai ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
tadap ke phir ye sada di hussain ne abbas
koi nahi hai is aafat mein jo bandhaye aas
tarayi chod ke aajao do ghadi ko paas
jawab maanga hai sughra ne kya likhun usko
ajeeb zid hai ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
tumhi batao ke mai dil ka haal kis se kahun
khareeb e asr hai mehman do ghadi ka hoon
bilak rahi hai wo dukhiya watan mein kya keh doon
raha hai kya mere paas ab usay batane ko
ajeeb zid hai ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
phir iske baad qasid se sheh ne farmaya
shaheed hogaye abbas chal basa dulha
ye dekh saamne akbar ka hai pada laasha
koi na aaya meri laash tak uthane ko
ajeeb zid hai ke...
<<DIVIDER>>
abhi sitam hai mujhe aur sehna ay qasid
sada kise hai zamane mein rehna ay qasid
ye jaa ke fatema sughra se kehna ay qasid
jo ho sake to wo ab bhool jaye asghar ko
ajeeb zid hai ke...
author: Sachey Bhai
